tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// go pe las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed bzhugs// ༄༅// gsung rab rin po che rnam par bkod pa'i mtshon byed ces bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dam pa rnams kyi rang bzhin ni// bla med sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus slad// bla na med pa'i dpal 'bras kun stsol ba'i// bla med bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// lhar bcas 'jig rten snang mdzad sgron ma mchog /lha brgya'i gtsug gi nor bus zhabs mchod cing*// lha min sde dang bcas pa zil gnon pa// lha yi lhar gyur lha mchog sangs rgyas rgyal// chos gang thog ma bar dang mthar dge bas// chos min rdul dang mun pa rnam bsal nas// chos kyi snang bas zhi ba'i dpal bskyed pa// chos bzang nges 'byin lam la phyag 'tshal lo// dge ba spyad pa'i rgyu las legs bskrun zhing*// dge legs lam la gcig tu gzhol gyur pa// dge 'dun rgya mtsho rgya mtsho'i sprin tshogs la// dge ba spel slad phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// skye 'gag du mar snang ba'i chos rnams kun// skye 'gag med pa'i dbyings su legs bstan pas// skye sogs srid zhi'i mtha' las rnam grol ba// skye med rgyal ba'i yum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ltar bskal pa'i mchog gyur bskal bzang gi// skye dgu'i tshe lo brgya pa'i dus babs tshe// shākya'i rgyal po chos kyi rgyal por byon// gsung rab rin chen 'gro la rab gsal gyur// des bstan bstan pa lnga brgya bdun pa la// 'dzam bus mtshon pa 'dzam gling byang phyogs su// hor gyi rigs byung rigs gzhan zil gnon pa// jing gir gan zhes rab grags grags chen des// rang gi dbang gis yul kun dbang du byas// de rjes rgyal rabs lnga pa'i rgyal po mchog /go pe la zhes 'gro la rab grags pas// rgyal thabs mdzad pas rgyal srid snga ma bas// ches cher 'phel zhing chos bzhin rnam par bskyangs// 'gro ba dpal 'byor gnyis kyis 'byor par gyur// sa bdag de ni bstan la rab gus shing*// khyad par bod khams dag la thugs brtse bas// gangs can skyong ba'i bkod pa rgya cher mdzad// bye brag mdo khams zal mo sgang zhes pa// shar nub lho byang sde dang yan lag bcas// kun la phan phyir kun gyi gtso bor ni// ston tshul zhes bya ba la dbang rab bskur// de yi grogs dang yul khams bsrung ba'i phyir// yu gur rigs byung ga ra go jo yi// mkhar du skyes pa ga nim du zhes bya// de yi bu ni du gal ga ya ste// de yi khyim zla dur mis de rim mo// de dag gi bu yug run ga ya ste// de yi nu bo ze 'un ga ya yin// tha chung e se na zhes bya ba 'di// lung dang bka' rtags phyag rgya dang bcas pa// nye bar bskos shing bskos pa'i bya ba bsgrubs// 'di yi bla ma srid gsum gsal mdzad pa// khams gsum rnam 'dren lam gsum ston pa po// sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes grags pa yin// de yi drin gyis bstan la rab zhugs nas// bstan pas bsgrub bya sangs rgyas thob phyir dang*// rgyal po yab sras btsun mor bcas pa rnams// sku tshe ring zhing chab srid brtan phyir dang*// pha ma sogs kyi drin lan bsabs phyir dang*// rgyal khams chos kyis shis par bya ba'i phyir// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yum gyur pa// shes rab pha rol phyin ma rgyas 'bring gsum// shing pho khyi lo'i ston zla rnam gsum la// smar khams tsom mdo gnas sar zhes bya bar// bzo sbyangs mkhas pa'i tshogs rnams spyan drangs te// baiḍūr+ya dang mtshungs pa'i gzhi rten la// gser bzang zhun mas legs par bzhengs nas kyang*// zhus dag dras dang glegs shing glegs thag dang*// na bza'i bar gyis rim gro cher bgyis shing*// dri med lung gi tshul las 'byung ba bzhin// rab tu gnas pa yongs su rdzogs bgyis te// kha na ma tho med cing dge ba yi// yo byad tshogs kyis bsnyen bkur 'bul ba bgyis// slad nas dge ba spel zhing rgyun bsring phyir// chos 'di legs par gsan zhing thugs chud pas// bsod nams zhing gi mchog la phul nas kyang*// klog dang kha ton mchod pa rgyas bgyid pa'i// bkod pa bgyis pa'i dge ba rgya chen dang*// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i dus gsum dge ba kun// lhag bsam dag pas gcig tu bsdoms bgyis nas// bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub dam pa thob par shog

/gnas skabs sa bdag yab sras sku tshe ring*// rgyal khams chos dang ldan zhing bde legs shog /bdag kyang tshe ring nad med bar chad zhi// bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin 'grub pa dang*// mi pham rgyal po mngon par byang chub tshe// de yis byang chub dam par lung ston shog /de lta'i don ston byed pa'i tshig sbyor 'di// shing mo phag lo bya sbo'i zla ba yi// bco lnga'i nyin par tsom mdo gnas sar du// legs par bris pa kun tu bde legs shog/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
